en: The postcard is an old, sepia-toned photograph featuring a nobleman and four children, all dressed in traditional attire, riding horses in what appears to be a formal garden or park setting. On the front, there is a caption in German: 'Der Fürst zu Waldeck und Pyrmont mit seinen Kindern' (The Prince of Waldeck and Pyrmont with his children). The reverse side contains a logo and text for 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont,' some handwritten notes, and the mark 'Hofphotograph Schlitzberger, Pyrmont.'
